Feature: GPIO register default and read/write integrity
Test Description: Validate per-pin GPIO register defaults and read/write integrity for GPIO_8 to GPIO_27. The test skips locations that are not readable or writable based on masks, writes a set of data patterns to writable bits, and verifies that reads match the expected combination of written bits and preserved default values for non-writable bits. The least significant bit is masked during default comparison due to input behavior.

Feature: Negative-edge GPIO input interrupt generation and handling
Test Description: Verify that a falling edge on each GPIO input triggers the corresponding interrupt, the group status reflects the correct pin, and all statuses can be cleared through the GPIO and system interrupt controller. The test configures per-pin control, enables the system and GPIO interrupt paths, generates one falling edge per pin using the pad control register, services the interrupt in an ISR, validates status bits, and clears them.
Meta Test Description: program.c defines test_case() and Default_IRQHandler(). test_case(): (1) Initialize test_err=0. Conditionally enable GIC IRQ 87 (GPIO0) or 88 (GPIO1) if GPIO0/GPIO1 compile flags are set. (2) Conditionally enable the system interrupt for the selected GPIO block by writing to INTR_EN1 with the respective GPIOx enable value. (3) Initialize external pad control at 0xA0243FFC to 0xFFFFFFFF (drive high). (4) For i=0..31: compute per-pin control address r = (GPIO_8 + i*4) and write a control value with bits 20,18,16 set; wait 10 cycles. (5) For i=0..31: wr_val = (1<<i); clear raw group status for this pin via GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; enable group interrupt for this pin by writing wr_val to gp0_intr2_intr_en1; wait 10 cycles; set int_pend=1; drive pads high (0xFFFFFFFF), wait 30; then drive pads to ~wr_val to generate a single-pin falling edge. Poll with timeout=5000 while (int_pend) with small waits; on timeout, print error for the specific GPIO index and increment test_err. After loop, finish(test_err). Default_IRQHandler(): compute local_wr=(1<<i); set int_pend=0; drive pads high (0xFFFFFFFF). Read per-pin control rdata from (GPIO_8 + i*4). If (rdata & 0x1) != 0 then increment test_err (input should be low after falling edge). If ((rdata & 0x2) != 0): read group status INTR1_INTR_STS1; if ((group_status & local_wr) == 0) then increment test_err; clear per-pin status by writing bits 20 and 16 to the per-pin control register; clear raw group status via GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1 with local_wr; read back INTR1_INTR_STS1 and if non-zero then increment test_err; clear the system raw interrupt in RAW_STCR1 for the respective GPIO block and clear the corresponding GIC IRQ (87/88). Else (no per-pin status) increment test_err.
Remarks: System interrupt controller must enable the GPIO interrupt source and the appropriate GIC IRQ line before testing. Ensure only one pad is toggled per iteration to avoid ambiguous group status. The pad control at 0xA0243FFC is used to generate edges for a single pin by inverting only that bit. A timeout indicates the ISR did not execute; verify interrupt routing if this occurs.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Enable the system interrupt path for the target GPIO instance in INTR_EN1 and enable the corresponding GIC IRQ (87 for GPIO0 or 88 for GPIO1). 2) Drive the external pad control register at 0xA0243FFC high to establish an idle state. 3) Configure each per-pin GPIO control register (GPIO_8 + i*4 for i=0..31) to enable and clear required interrupt control/state bits for falling-edge detection. 4) For each pin i from 0 to 31: clear its raw group interrupt status in GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1; enable the group interrupt for that pin in gp0_intr2_intr_en1. 5) For each pin i: arm the test flag, generate a falling edge on only that pin using 0xA0243FFC (transition from high to low for bit i), and wait for the ISR to run within the timeout. 6) In the ISR, verify the per-pin input indicates low, the group status asserts the correct pin, then clear the per-pin and group raw statuses and clear the system raw interrupt; ensure group status returns to zero. 7) Report PASS if no timeouts or status validation errors occurred; otherwise report FAIL.
